title: RFC 9636 TZif structural validation report (zic-rs-tzif-validation-v1)
description: Five separate typed verdicts (structural/footer/reader-compat/leap-expiry/version) over emitted and reference TZif; bounds-safe, never one valid:true. Published contract scope: this pins the schema **identity** (the `schema` const) and the top-level object shape. Field-level tightening and full instance-validation against a JSON-Schema validator are a tracked audit-suite item (the core crate carries no validator dependency); see docs/schema-compatibility-policy.md for the versioning rules and tests/schemas.rs for the registry/drift guard.

schema.description: the immutable schema identity; bumped only on a meaning change
